note: Operator request and ordinary baseline for the 20 June 2024 review, reconstructed as if Akoustis applied to Slope for a reusable line that pays supplier invoices. Terms reconstructed by applying Slope's published sizing rule to the connected-bank baseline. The baseline holds only ordinary underwriting facts; the litigation is for the investigation to establish.

requested_use.value: Draws on a Slope reusable line to pay supplier invoices (fab materials and contract manufacturing)

requested_term.value: Reusable line; each draw repaid in three monthly installments

run_inputs.initial_event_seed: As of 20 June 2024, analyse how external events could affect a Slope reusable line that pays supplier invoices for Akoustis Technologies, Inc., each draw repaid in three monthly installments. Akoustis's public filings describe trade-secret and patent litigation with Qorvo, Inc., a competitor, in the U.S. District Court for the District of Delaware.

financing_plan.funding: next business day after the review date (Slope pays the supplier)
financing_plan.note: Slope pays the supplier up to the financed amount; Akoustis pays any remainder of the invoice itself.

supplied_terms.product: Slope reusable line: Slope pays supplier invoices up to the limit; each draw is repaid in monthly installments by ACH

line.label: Terms reconstructed by applying Slope's published sizing rule to the connected-bank baseline.
line.rule: limit = 15% x (mean monthly customer_receipts - mean monthly debt_service), trailing three complete months
line.reassessment: same rule at every draw date, on each trajectory's trailing receipts (next engine step)
line.draw_rule: each supplier_invoice outflow is routed while outstanding + invoice <= the day's limit, no installment is overdue and no petition has been filed

supplied_draw.basis: largest supplier invoice in the trailing window that fits under the limit
